title: Papasena Language (PAS) – L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map ...
text: Papasena is an endangered indigenous language of Indonesia. It belongs to the Lakes Plain language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by a decreasing number of young people. It is not known to be taught in schools.
